definitions.explanation: Sincere, careful effort put into making or raising something over time, such as growing vegetables, tending a garden, or crafting an object by hand.

examples.japanese: {丹精|たんせい}⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make something with loving care.
Flowers bloomed in the garden my grandmother had tended so carefully.

examples.japanese: ⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{丹精|たんせい}⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧お⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦やはり→やはり：01991_yahari⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Rice that farmers have grown with such care really does taste different.

notes:
Almost always met in the set phrase {丹精|たんせい}⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧ (with loving care), which appears constantly in food packaging and advertising for farm produce and handmade goods. Written {丹精|たんせい} or {丹誠|たんせい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丹精|たんせい}⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise or grow with loving care
- {丹精|たんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}める→込める：01945_komeru⟧: to put one's heart into
- {丹精|たんせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take great pains over (a garden, a crop)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧: sincerely, with feeling — more general, also for letters and gifts
- ⟦{端正|たんせい}→端正：14887_tansei⟧: neat, well-proportioned (of features) — a different word with the same reading
